finding.title: Boolean availability clock coerces into causal timestamp and passes PIT
finding.fixture: FlowObservation.from_dict({family:'etf',metric:'net_flow_usd',asset:'BTC',value:10,unit:'USD',effective_at_ms:100,available_at_ms:true,observed_at_ms:2000,source:'src',source_record_id:'row1'}), then point_in_time_filter([obs],500); compare available_at_ms:null and integer 1000.
finding.source_predicted: int(true)==1 so availability=1ms; point_in_time_filter at 500ms admits row; null excluded; integer 1000 excluded.
expected: Reject boolean causal *_ms fields or mark availability unknown, never treat True/False as valid PIT timestamps.
At as_of_ms=500, boolean-availability row excluded/rejected; null and future integer availability remain excluded.
Valid integer millisecond timestamps preserve existing PIT semantics.
